section_title: Historian, performance monitoring and operator training simulator
text: Plant historian: a redundant historian server with 5 years of on-line storage (ER-12.05); all DCS, TCS, SIS, package and CEMS signals are archived, including all TCS signals (TQ-026), with the capacity for the number of archived tags of the historian record (00CKA10) plus 20 % spare; time-stamped at the source; data are not compressed for trip-relevant tags (a 1 s or faster recording, and high-resolution 100 ms snapshot on a trip).
